page.layout: One page of text in a single column of index entries; running head "IOA" at top centre; page number "358" at top left; a fragment of another page (right margin, mostly illegible show-through and edge) is not transcribed.

main_text.p: latur Iehonias, 37.1. appellatur Neri, Lucæ 3.27. succedit ei patruus Matthanias, 2. Reg. 24.17. (Iehoiakim. 1. Domini resurrectio.)
main_text.l: IOACIM, qui & Eliacim, filius Iosiæ, Rex Iuda constituitur, 2. Reg. 23.34. 2. Paral. 36.4. eius ruina prædicitur, Ierem. 22.18. Ieremiæ volumen comburi iubet, 36.23. vinctus Babylonem transportatur, 2. Paralip. 36.6. moritur, 2. Reg. 24.6. eius sepultura ignominiosa, Ieremiæ 22.19. & 36.30.
IOADAN, vel (vt alij legunt) Ioiadan, Amasiæ Regis Iuda mater, 2. Reg. 14.2. 2. Paral. 25.1. (i. Domini deliciæ)
IOANNA vxor Chusæ sequitur Christum, Luc. 8.3. & 24.10.
IOAS, Gedeonis pater, Iudic. 6.11. Cultores Baal de suo a Gedeone confracto idolo conquerentes irridet, v.31. eiúsque patronis mortem minatur, ibid.

IOAS, Ochosiæ filius, natu minimus, a Iosaphat ne interficiatur, adhuc puer a sorore absconditur, 2. Reg. 11.2. 2. Par. 22. 1. regno Iudæ inauguratur, 2. Reg. 11.12.2. paral. 23.11. eius pietas, 2. Reg. 12.2. a servis occiditur, & quare, v.21. 2. paral. 24.25. sepultura eius minimè regia: ibid.

IOAS, filius Ioachaz, Rex Israel, patri succedit, 2. Regum 13. v. 9.10. eius impietas, v.11. insolens eius ad Amasiam regē Iuda responsum, 14.9.2. Paral. 25.18. eius in eundem victoria, 2. Regnum 14.12.2. Paral. 25.22.23. capto Amasia, Ierusalé ingreditur, expilat, & eius muri partem euertit, 2. Reg. 14, v.13 14.2 Paral. 25. v.23.24. moritur, 2 Reg. 13.13. & 14, 16. (Iehoas. 1. fundamentum Domini).
IOATHAN, filius Gedeonis postremus, manus Abimelech euadit, Iudic. 9.5. de electo Abimelech Rege apud Sichimitas conqueritur, 9. v.7.8.9. &c. eis imprecatur, v.19.20. (Iothan. 1. Domini perfectio.)
IOATHAN, filius Hoziæ, in regno Iuda patri succedit, 2. Reg. 15.32.2. Paral. 26.23. vincit Ammonitas, 27.5. moritur, 2 Reg. 15 38.2. Paral. 27.9. Cui successit Achaz: ibid.
main_text.p: IOB pius & rectus, Iob. 1.1. & 2.3. & 27.6. & 29.12. ditissimus est, 1.3. vlcere pessimo percutitur. 2.7. ab amicis inuisitur, vers. 11. miserè afflictus diei suo maledicit, 3.1. de sui mali gravitate queritur, 6.2. mortem optat, v.8.9. & 7.15. & 10. v.1.18. amicos suos temeritatis arguit, 6.25. se a fratribus & familiaribus destitutum queritur, v.13.15. & 19. v.13.14. insomniis & visionibus terretur, 7.14. blasphemiç ab amicis

page.notes: Right margin fragment (another page's text, show-through and edge) not transcribed. Several words in the index are doubtful, notably "Ierusalé", "Ammonitas" and the section beginning "IOB"; the last line is printed in a smaller, offset position at the right and is transcribed as read.
